requirements.quote:
TCP connection remains in the TIME_WAIT state.  Therefore, a proxy
   cannot rely on SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS alone to limit the
   resources consumed by CONNECT requests.
requirements.condition: When a proxy limits resources consumed by CONNECT requests.
requirements.required_behavior: The proxy must use resource-limiting measures beyond SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS alone.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The proxy must not rely solely on SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS to limit resources consumed by CONNECT requests.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation configuration and resource-control paths can be inspected or tested to determine whether CONNECT resource limits depend exclusively on the concurrent-stream setting.

requirements.condition: When an implementation communicates on a secure channel and content contains both confidential and attacker-controlled data without separate compression dictionaries for the two sources.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The implementation must not compress the content.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply mixed confidential and attacker-controlled content over a secure channel and verify that compression is disabled unless separate dictionaries are used.

requirements.condition: When an intermediary forwards a padded DATA frame.
requirements.required_behavior: The intermediary should retain the DATA frame padding.
requirements.why_checkable: A padded DATA frame can be passed through an intermediary and the forwarded frame checked for retained padding.

   padding for HEADERS and PUSH_PROMISE frames.  A valid reason for an
requirements.condition: When an intermediary forwards a padded HEADERS or PUSH_PROMISE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: The intermediary is permitted to drop the frame padding.
requirements.why_checkable: Forwarded HEADERS and PUSH_PROMISE frames can be observed to confirm that dropping their padding is an allowed implementation behavior.

requirements.quote:
Ensuring that processing time is not dependent on the value of a
   secret is the best defense against any form of timing attack.
requirements.condition: When request processing uses a secret and resistance to remote timing attacks is required.
requirements.required_behavior: Processing time should not depend on the value of the secret.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Processing behavior must not expose secret-dependent timing variation.
requirements.why_checkable: Focused timing tests can compare processing-time distributions across different secret values to detect secret-dependent variation.
